name: Send campaign now
description: Call this when you need to send a marketing campaign immediately. Use the "schedule campaign" action instead if you want to set a future send time rather than sending instantly.
preconditions: The campaign with the given ID must exist.

Inferred from the send wizard, not observed: the campaign must have a validated sender, a saved recipient list or segment, and a saved subject and design. The wizard enforces these in order and this endpoint is the last of five calls, so it was never reached with any of them missing.
Inferred: the campaign must still be a draft. A campaign already sent, scheduled or suspended is not re-sendable through this endpoint.
Inferred: the account's sending allowance for the day must not be exhausted. The capture comes from a free-tier account, where that allowance is a daily cap rather than a plan quota.

id.description: Identifier of the campaign to send immediately.

side_effects: The campaign is sent immediately to its intended recipients.
Irreversible. Real people receive the email and there is no recall, which is why this entry is destructive even though it creates nothing and deletes nothing.
